description: This file defines a class named ProxyGrain that implements the IProxyGrain interface within a Orleans-based distributed application. It manages a proxy to another grain (ITestGrain), providing methods to create the proxy and retrieve runtime identifiers.

classes.name: ProxyGrain
classes.description: A grain class that acts as a proxy to another grain (ITestGrain), providing methods to instantiate and communicate with the proxy.

methods.name: CreateProxy
methods.description: Initializes the proxy grain with a specified key, establishing a reference to the target grain.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the runtime identity of this grain instance.

methods.name: GetProxyRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime identity of the proxied grain.
